changed_rows.rationale: Explicit review of changed Darwin futimens signature: fd:i32, shared reference to two CLayout<DarwinTimespec> elements, result:i32. DarwinTimespec is exactly signed64 seconds and signed64 nanoseconds, matching the installed primary Apple timespec/futimens declarations and the source two-element array, rather than the old custom timestamp-record signature. Current provider guards32 input bytes, decodes four words into aligned typed two-element storage and calls the same libSystem _futimens binding. Requirement/source owner, macos_arm64 target, binding producer, dylib/symbol and service envelope are preserved; published requirement reaches FilesystemMetadataMutation. This is an exact representation/signature update, not a new service grant. Runtime execution of futimens is not qualified by this review.

Console::read_byte permission has exactly the historical accepted payload with only owning root package substituted. Current root imports Console, declares reaches Console and selects ordinary ProgramEntry on all four hosted targets; this review is macos_arm64. The Console public service includes byte input/output and process exit; accepting the row does not claim that this exit65 witness performs input/output or donate filesystem authority.
